answer_1.quote: Our approach differs from other methods in that it is not specialized for a specific task, such as arithmetic, but rather designed for general language modeling tasks involving text with numerical values.

answer_2.quote: Tab. 1 compares the results of training with plain numbers to training with the NumeroLogic encoding. ... a model trained with plain numbers reached 88.37% and 73.76% accuracy, respectively, while with the Nu-meroLogic encoding, the tasks are almost solved (99.96% and 97.2%).
